svg.text: Connectors = MCP Servers, One Click Away
Every card is tagged ‘MCP · Catalog’: a connector is an MCP server packaged for one-click install.

g.text: plug that lets any agent talk to an
outside app through a small server.
Not in the catalog? ‘Add your own’
same thing hermes mcp add does.
We’ll wire MCP servers in by hand,
so you’ll know exactly what this
Install button is doing for you.
Tools are built in. Connectors bring in the rest of the world: your work apps, your data, your cloud, through one standard plug.
